headline: Approved permits and a one-day alcohol license for the River City Rhythm & Rock Festival at Riverfront Park.
summary: The commission approved an amended entertainment permit for Summer Praise Fest at 800 South Street, moving its end time to 5:30 PM. Derek Craig said he requested two police details for his festival. The applicant for a September 5 live music event at Riverfront Park withdrew the application.
decisions: Approved amended entertainment permit for Summer Praise Fest at 800 South Street, with end time of 5:30 PM, by 3-0 vote.
Approved entertainment permit for River City Rhythm & Rock Festival on August 29, 2026, by 3-0 vote.
Let the applicant withdraw the Celebrate Recovery live music application for September 5, 2026, by 3-0 vote.
Approved special one-day all alcoholic beverage license for River City Rhythm & Rock Festival on August 29, 2026, by 3-0 vote.

decision_evidence.quote: Amended application approved by unanimous roll call vote 3/0.

      BOARD OF LICENSE COMMISSIONERS 
         City Hall, 718 Main Street 
              Fitchburg MA  01420 
              (978) 829-1820

Richard Boscardin 
Glenn Fossa 
MINUTES OF SPECIAL MEETING 
A special meeting of the Board of L icense Commissioners was held on Thurs day, August 13, 2026 VIA 
zoom and called to order by Commissioner Sarefield at 9:01 AM. Commissioner Boscardin  and 
Commissioner Fossa were present. City Clerk Joanna Bilotta and Assistant City Clerk Elizabeth McN iff 
was present.  
 
I. NEW APPLICATIONS 
Please note that the Commission may enter into Executive Session pursuant to G.L. c. 30A, sec. 21(a) 
(5) (Discussion of CORI results), if required during this portion of the agenda, and will return to 
regular session upon completion. 
 
Monday-Saturday Entertainment Permit  
Jane Riddle, Church of the Nazarene, Summer Praise Fest, 800 South Street, Saturday, August 15, 
2026, for DJ, from 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM for approximately 100 people. 
Ms. Riddle was present at the meeting. Commissioner Sarefield reviewed the application and verified 
that Ms. Riddle is aware that the entertainment must be shut down thirty minutes prior to closing. Ms. 
Riddle asked to amend the end time to 5:30 PM.  
Amended application approved by unanimous roll call vote 3/0. 
Derek Craig, River City Rhythm & Rock Festival, Riverfront Park, 0 Boulder Drive, Saturday, August 
29, 2026, for DJ, live amplified and acoustic music, and dancing, from 11:00 AM to 11:00 PM for 
approximately 1000 people. 
Mr. Craig was present at the meeting. Commissioner Sarefield reviewed the application and verified 
that Mr. Craig is aware that the entertainment must be shut down thirty minutes prior to closing. Mr. 
Craig shared with the commission that he requested two police details for the event.  
Application approved by unanimous roll call vote 3/0. 
Tara Rivera, Celebrate Recovery, Riverfront Park, 0 Boulder Drive, Saturday, September 5, 2026, for 
live amplified music, from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM for approximately 100 people. 
City Clerk Joanna Bilotta informed the commission that the applicant had withdrawn their application.  
Application given leave to withdraw by unanimous roll call vote 3/0.
Page 2 
 
Special One Day All Alcoholic Beverage License  
Derek Craig, River City Rhythm & Rock Festival, Riverfront Park, 0 Boulder Drive, Saturday, August 
29, 2026, from 11:00 AM to 11:00 PM for approximately 1000 people. 
Mr. Craig was present at the meeting. Commissioner Sarefield reviewed the application and verified 
that the events will have TIP certified servers. Commissioner Sarefield stated that all serving of alcohol 
must be ceased thirty minutes prior to closing. Mr. Craig stated that he will have TIP certified servers 
and had also partnered with Rise & Grind and some of their TIP certified employees would be working 
the event as well. Mr. Craig explained it will be the same set up beer garden as last year, in a topped off 
area. City Clerk Joanna Bilotta reminded Mr. Craig that he would need to forfeit his liquor license for 
the evening at his establishment while he was operating this special one day under his name.  
Application approved by unanimous roll call vote 3/0.  
 
  
NEXT REGULAR MEETING 
 
Thursday, September 3, 2026 
 
 
 
The meeting adjourned at 9:33 AM 
 
Respectfully submitted, 
 
 
Joanna Bilotta, City Clerk
